name: PGH
note: Every street, trail and bridge in the Pittsburgh corridor. No traffic and no set route: straight on at every junction unless you choose a turn

name: CNY
note: Every street and trail round Camillus, Warners and Amboy, with the Erie Canalway Trail. No traffic and no set route: straight on at every junction unless you choose a turn

name: SKAN
note: Every road and trail round Skaneateles and Marcellus, and all the way round Skaneateles and Otisco lakes: villages, farms and woods. No traffic and no set route: straight on at every junction unless you choose a turn

name: NYC
note: Central Park in peak fall: the drives, the bridle path and the main paths, past Bethesda Terrace, Bow Bridge, Belvedere Castle and the Reservoir. The gates are closed: the ride stays in the park. Free both ways, straight on at every junction unless you choose a turn
